meta_descript: Discover our collaboration with @Mi_Gfx02 for the Blue Samurai — a unique Japan football kit concept blending history and contemporary design.
content:
A Successful Collaboration with @Mi_Gfx02 for the "Blue Samurai"

We are thrilled to present the second design in our "Kit Concepts" collection — an inspiring collaboration with @Mi_Gfx02. With his undeniable talent, he has created a unique vision for the Japan national team.

A Kit Design Virtuoso

@Mi_Gfx02's passion lies in designing football kits for teams from around the world, blending history with contemporary aesthetics. "Every nation brings its heritage onto the pitch. My goal is to capture that spirit in my designs."

Embodying Japanese Culture

This design for the "Blue Samurai" perfectly captures the essence of Japan. The iconic crest features a samurai with his sword, set against a white and red background evoking the Japanese flag. The black body is adorned with enigmatic thin grey stripes, echoing the mystique of samurai warriors. Red details complete this masterpiece.

The Community's Favourite

Faced with two remarkable options, we polled our loyal fans. With 60% of the votes, the bold and refined black design came out on top!

Unique Concepts, Our Shared Passion

At MOMUTO, we offer fully customisable kits. With this "Concepts" collection, we spotlight predefined designs born from exclusive collaborations — all driven by the same passion for pushing the boundaries of this art form.

Stay Tuned for What's Next

Keep an eye out for upcoming collaborations and innovative concepts coming to this unique collection. We warmly thank @Mi_Gfx02 for this fruitful partnership, and you, our community, for your unwavering support. Together, let's keep celebrating football and design!

Share your ideas in the comments or on Twitter and Instagram to help shape our next collaborations!
